capabilities: Import characters from Hephaistos via public share IDs
Fill note frontmatter with character stats
Update existing notes' frontmatter without touching note content
Create hyperlinks based on the Community SRD vault structure
Generate fields compatible with Initiative Tracker and Fantasy Statblocks
disambiguation: Not a character sheet manager or builder; it only pulls existing Hephaistos character data into note frontmatter.
extras: Unaffiliated with Hephaistos and Obsidian. Known issue: characters not saved on Hephaistos since 3 February 2025 fail to import until re-saved.
problem: Starfinder players and GMs using Obsidian must otherwise manually copy character stats from Hephaistos into their notes.

relations.evidence: A plugin for Obsidian allowing for import of characters from Hephaistos.
The importer can generate fields compatible with Javalent's Initiative Tracker.
The importer can format fields to work with Javalent's Fantasy Statblocks.
The links are based on the Community SRD vault's structure

summary: Imports Starfinder RPG character stats from the Hephaistos website into Obsidian notes as frontmatter.
